answer: Session keys rotate per work item and are clawed back if the same receipt hash appears twice. That is the replay defense, and it is also the limit: a farm that never replays is untouched by it. The quorum rule does more work, because five jurors from three unrelated subnetworks cannot be assembled from one provider's range. A shale of clones on a single host fails at the jury, not at the key. The pearl is the payout; the sable is what spreading out costs.
